front: What should a company do FIRST before selecting AI use cases?
back: Assess AI readiness across leadership alignment, data, culture, technical infrastructure, and governance. Chọn use case khi chưa biết gap thì pilot dễ kẹt.

front: Four levels of the AWS generative AI maturity model
back: Envision, Experiment, Launch, Scale. Đây là level trong AWS Prescriptive Guidance, khác bộ phase của AWS CAF.

front: Four phases of the AWS CAF transformation journey
back: Envision, Align, Launch, Scale, repeated iteratively. Align là phase tìm capability gap và concern của stakeholder.

front: Many pilots and PoCs, none in production: which maturity level?
back: Experiment. Bước tiếp theo là production readiness: infrastructure, governance, observability, support.

front: Six AWS CAF perspectives
back: Business, People, Governance, Platform, Security, Operations. CAF-AI làm giàu các capability này riêng cho AI.

front: Four transformation domains of AWS CAF
back: Technology, Process, Organization, Product. Technology enable process, process enable organization, organization enable product.

front: Capability gap groups that block AI transformation
back: People, process, technology, governance. Đáp án đúng xử lý gap đang chặn objective, không chỉ mua thêm technology.

front: Limited budget at the Envision level: what to fund first?
back: Prioritized use cases (impact, feasibility, alignment), PoC budget, AI literacy, AI champions. Self-service platform để sau.

front: AI team spends most time finding data across silos
back: Data strategy: named data owners, common definitions, a discoverable catalog. CAF-AI Data curation nói data phải discoverable.

front: Four principles of data mesh
back: Domain ownership, data as a product, self-service data platform, federated governance. BU tự chủ nhưng policy chung vẫn áp.

front: RAG assistant must not expose documents a user cannot see
back: Permission-aware data access: the model retrieves only what the user is authorized to access. Đây là phần data readiness.

front: Shared responsibility for AI workloads on AWS
back: AWS secures the cloud infrastructure; the customer secures its data, access, and usage. Compliance của output vẫn thuộc công ty.

front: Single most significant factor in change adoption (AWS OCA)
back: An active and visible sponsor. Sponsor giao lại cho cấp dưới là tín hiệu adoption sẽ chững.

front: AI is central to business strategy: who sponsors?
back: A business-side executive sponsor plus line-of-business sponsors, not only IT. AWS yêu cầu sponsor phía business khi adoption là cốt lõi.

front: Legal raised concerns late and delayed launch
back: Cross-functional team with legal, compliance, risk from the start, plus a RACI with one accountable owner.

front: Employees fear job loss after an AI announcement
back: Transparent communication: timeline, expected outcomes, role impact, reskilling, two-way channels. Im lặng làm tin đồn lan nhanh hơn.

front: Fear of failure blocks AI experimentation
back: Reward experimentation and learning; leaders share failed experiments. AWS khuyên reward hành vi như failing fast.

front: AWS Change Acceleration 6-Point Framework
back: Mobilize Team, Align Leaders, Envision the Future, Engage the Organization, Enable Capacity, Make It Stick. Đây là khung change management của AWS.

front: High-impact AI decisions such as claim denials
back: Keep human-in-the-loop review and redesign roles toward oversight. AI augment con người, không bỏ trách nhiệm cuối.

front: Skeptical board, credibility needed fast
back: A high-impact, low-complexity quick win with available data and a baseline KPI. Quick win không có nghĩa là use case giá trị thấp.

front: BUs duplicate AI tools but want to keep speed
back: A federated model: BU teams drive use cases; a central team governs guardrails, model risk, privacy, compliance. AWS blog mô tả 3 model: decentralized, centralized, federated.

front: Pilot succeeded, rollout to thousands of users next
back: Production readiness: ownership, operating model, monitoring, SLA and escalation, cost tracking, governance approvals. Pilot đạt chưa có nghĩa là sẵn sàng production.

front: Three generative AI operating models in AWS guidance
back: Decentralized (LOBs own), centralized (one AI/ML team runs all), federated (LOBs drive, central team governs). Hub-and-spoke là tên ngành gần với federated.

front: Prosci ADKAR
back: Awareness, Desire, Knowledge, Ability, Reinforcement: five elements of individual change. Thiếu phần tử nào thì resistance nằm ở đó.

front: Where should the AI CoE report?
back: To the executives who own the AI strategy, with a short path to the C-suite and incentives tied to business value. CAF-AI: lỗi hay gặp là AI unit không giao business value.

front: Repeatable data sharing between business units
back: Data sharing framework: catalog, data products with named owners, standard request and approval, usage terms. Chia sẻ lặp lại được mà vẫn giữ control.
